en: Vintage sepia postcard with two photographic panels. The left panel shows the damaged interior of a Catholic church: partially collapsed masonry, gothic altar and crucifix, and rubble on the floor with a person standing among the ruins. The right panel shows a town market square with tents and townspeople, and a damaged church visible in the background. Polish captions and title are printed in red around and below the images.
